blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some of the Chinese firms that sent a total of P319.32 million to Cale88 Foods Corp., a company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, are Chinese state-owned enterprises, Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros told the impeachment court on Tuesday. Hontiveros put this on record even as Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) […]... Keep on reading: Hontiveros: China ‘state firms’ among Cale88 funders
